note: A 35-year-old VFX freelancer in the first weeks of building his own studio — an aspiring business owner rather than an established one, and he ruled himself out on money before the price was even given ('I'm not rich', later 'too much at the moment'). He fits the training half of the ICP well: already trains functional three times a week, is not deconditioned, and wants good-to-great improvements in mobility, muscle and body fat rather than rescue. The stated ICP has no clinical criterion, which matters here — a lumbar vertebral protrusion and an operation one month prior would be the real disqualifier on this call, and nothing in the ICP catches it.
